widgets.name: Work Order Card
widgets.description: Displays a generated maintenance work order: urgency level, triggered sensors, recommended repair actions, and estimated remaining life.

examples.name: Critical Engine Example
examples.description: Work order for an engine with high-severity anomalies across all sensors (real NASA C-MAPSS FD001 unit 3, run to real failure)

data.issueDescription: high severity anomalies in rotationalSpeed, pressure, temperature.
recommendedActions: Inspect drive-train and fuel control unit; recalibrate governor.
Inspect and clean compressor stages; check for seal wear and downstream restriction.
Inspect and service cooling system; check thermocouples and combustor liner for wear.

examples.name: Healthy Engine Example
examples.description: Work order for a healthy engine with no anomaly detected

data.issueDescription: No anomaly detected. Machine is operating within normal baseline parameters.
recommendedActions: No action required. Continue routine monitoring.
